newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takefuji shares down sharply in morning.
newsitem.headline: Takefuji shares down sharply in morning.

text.p: Shares in major Japanese consumer finance firm Takefuji Corp fell sharply in Tuesday morning trade as stop-loss selling continued, traders said.

Since the price was far below the opening level of 10,200 yen marked on the first day the share was traded in the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Friday, those who had long positions continued selling in order to cut their losses, they said.
As of 0142 GMT, the share price was down 110 yen at 9,520 yen. It briefly slipped to a low of 9,210 yen.
